name: Anime Ghosts [🔥]
desc:
👻 Welcome to Anime Ghosts! 👻

🌍 Explore incredible anime worlds!
⚡ Tap to gain energy — every click brings you closer to power!
📜 Open scrolls to collect companions who will help you!
⚔️ Fight enemies to earn resources, unlock avatars, weapons, and discover rare items !
📈 Rank up. Upgrade everything! 
🏰 Epic battles and challenging dungeons.

✨Discover why Anime Ghosts is a favorite among adventure and strategy simulator enthusiasts. Enter the world of Anime Ghosts now and begin your journey to become the best!

💻📱🎮 Available on computers, phones, tablets, and consoles!
